product_updates.title: Trajectory raises $45M to make AI model training accessible to nontechnical experts
product_updates.content: The one-year-old startup is now valued at $300 million.

product_updates.title: Anthropic warns that it’s very close to RSI capability, aka self-building AI
product_updates.content: RSI is the point at which AI grows so good at training itself that it spawns a dramatic acceleration of AI capabilities. To the AI doomers, RSI represents the cataclysm from which there is no return.

product_updates.title: Web host Squarespace lays off 19% of its employees
product_updates.content: The website builder said that the job losses are part of a broader restructuring of its organization.

product_updates.title: New York Times and other outlets sue web browser Brave over alleged content scraping
product_updates.content: The New York Times is suing privacy-focused web browser company Brave for allegedly scraping the outlet’s copyrighted content and unlawfully distributing it to its own customers, like Anthropic and Perplexity.

product_updates.title: 42AI comes out of stealth with $62.5M and a world model that can ‘predict human behavior’
product_updates.content: Here's a question straight out of sci-fi: What if AI could predict what you were going to do before you decided to, even in a completely new situation?

product_updates.title: Elon Musk throttles Grok Bot limits due to ‘unsustainably high’ costs
product_updates.content: Musk recently referred to Grok Bot as having "the fastest growth of a product that I've ever seen in my life."

product_updates.title: Omen AI adds liquid know-how in $16 million Aquatic Labs acquisition
product_updates.content: Two startups tackling the data center water problem are joining forces in a $16 million deal.

product_updates.title: 2 days till TechCrunch Founder Summit: Boston founders don’t need a Silicon Valley address to build something big
product_updates.content: TechCrunch Founder Summit happens on November 4 in Boston for a founder-focused agenda and impactful connections. Save up to $100 or get discounts with group passes.

product_updates.title: OpenAI is finally merging ChatGPT’s Chat and Work tabs
product_updates.content: OpenAI said that ChatGPT and Codex will draw usage from the same allocation pool after this change.
